run_SCAN_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher class to load and serve SCAN dataset dialog examples in ParlAI
build_SCAN_data: build and download the SCAN dataset by calling the build function with a ParlAI option dict
get_SCAN_data_path: get the SCAN dataset file path for a given datatype using the _path helper function
create_fb_format_from_SCAN: create Facebook dialog format files from SCAN raw data using the create_fb_format function
review_DefaultTeacher_init: review the DefaultTeacher class __init__ method to understand how it configures the SCAN datafile path
